The following events took place in '''18 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Corellian Crisis]].<ref name="AaC">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref><ref name="AaS">''[[Assault at Selonia]]''</ref><ref name="SaC">''[[Showdown at Centerpoint]]''</ref>
**Destruction of [[TD-10036-EM-1271]] and the [[Thanta Zilbra system/Legends|Thanta Zilbra system]] by [[Centerpoint Station]].<ref name="AaC" />
*The [[Human League]] was established by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
*Resignation from the office of [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], election of [[Ponc Gavrisom]] to continue the remainder of Organa term.
*The [[Constitutional Protectorate of Prakith]] sued for peace with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] following the death of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Foga Brill/Legends|Foga Brill]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*Wedding of [[Tionne Solusar|Tionne]] and [[Kam Solusar]].<ref name="TNEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>
